_comment: Single source of truth for SEO. useDocumentHead.ts reads this to set per-route head tags, and scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs reads it to write public/sitemap.xml at build time. Add a route here and both stay in step. Any route NOT listed here is treated as non-indexable: it gets noindex and is kept out of the sitemap. Match-flow, profile, shop, settings and admin screens are non-indexable on purpose.

routes.title: MS Battle - Play multiplayer Minesweeper online
